gen-comfortaa-fs-epilogue: Neon-tube friendliness, as Comfortaa loops wide and loose while Epilogue stands taller below with stubby ascenders and a wiry line. Let the sans body text go a touch larger than usual.
gen-comfortaa-gf-science-gothic: Springy neon-tube loops from Comfortaa, then Science Gothic below. Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, stroke ends set far apart, so a full page moves at a slow pace.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-suwannaph: Dignified and editorial, the serif text here stands tall, with a c open like a bent paperclip. Suwannaphum does that quietly, while Alien Encounters earns attention with big gaps between letter pairs and a high x-height.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-instrument-s: Instrument Sans keeps every stroke at the same weight, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers. But Alien Encounters, with its wide gaps and high x-height, supplies the otherworldly strangeness the plain sans leaves out.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-inter: Inter reads smooth and tube-like, its big counters breathing open. Alien Encounters does the otherworldly work up top with wide gaps, while sans-serif Inter keeps its strokes constant and unshaded.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-roboto-slab: Wide-set, otherworldly display letters meet a precise, structured slab-serif body. Alien Encounters earns its keep big and short, while Roboto Slab holds the line with open throats and a dominant middle zone.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-halant: Broad, commanding Amadeus stretches across the line without a tilt. Halant, a serif with faintly shifting stroke weight and a towering x-height, gives it a traditional, authoritative counterweight below.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Wide, commanding Amadeus stretches across the line with strokes of one fixed width, round letters sitting upright and untilted. Hedvig Letters Serif adds sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase and medium contrast.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-noto-serif-hentaig: Amadeus stretches wide across the line, its round letters bent from a single wire with no tilt. Noto Serif Hentaigana unfolds line after line, modest contrast rewarding a close look.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Floating geometry first: Arkhip spaces its letters well apart, with no stroke modulation. BhuTuka Expanded One, classic serif with curvy, unclamped letters, slows reading to a leisurely, literary walk.
